title: Static in the Hallway
lyric_excerpt: The fluorescent buzz keeps chewing on my name
I drag my shoes through the same old drain
The room hums like a broken signal
I keep my teeth clenched and call it grace

guitar.feel: Palm-muted verse rhythm, dirty chorus lead
guitar.note: Let the top string ring at the end of each phrase

drums.verse: Kick on 1 and 3, snare on 2 and 4, hats on 8ths
drums.chorus: Louder snare, more kick accents, crash on 4 after the fill
